pages.text: 卡迭石咒印是整条故事线的起点。它会把佩戴者卷入九重诅咒，并逐步把更多饰品、被动、试炼与反转接口推到你面前。$(br2)如果你只是第一次接触这个模组，先从咒印、净化卷轴、杜阿特余烬和杜阿特之心读起。

pages.title: 卡迭石咒印
pages.text: 王朝故事的真正入口。佩戴后，随机负面、幸运惩罚、税契、王罪、物品封印、维度触发等机制都会陆续启动。

pages.title: Curse II: Crown of Regency
pages.text: While the Seal of Kadesh is worn, Curse II continuously lowers Luck based on cumulative wear time. Villagers encountered within the configured radius are always converted into zombie villagers.$(br2)Villager infection can be disabled and its detection radius configured. After Curse II is reversed, infection stops, the Luck penalty becomes a bonus, and the crown may still send brief loyal retainers.

pages.title: Curse VII: End Judgment
pages.text: Entering the End permanently awakens its judgment. By default, one effective killing attack is randomly chosen within every 1-to-7 cycle, and that kill produces no loot.$(br2)Marked enchanted weapons are also checked once for enchantment erasure when they enter the player's inventory.

pages.title: Config and Enchantments
pages.text: Enchantment erasure is enabled by default at 35%. Experience and materials are consumed first, while the enchanting interface only registers a pending server-side check. The roll occurs once the weapon actually enters the player's inventory, without modifying the item or options inside the enchanting interface. Enchanted weapons generated in loot chests follow the same inventory-entry rule.$(br2)Curse VII's no-loot trigger limit, enchantment-erasure toggle, and erasure chance are configurable, and the seal's Ctrl tooltip shows their current values.

pages.title: 推进顺序
pages.text: 推荐顺序：$(br)1. 佩戴卡迭石咒印$(br)2. 取得净化卷轴，理解王罪$(br)3. 在下界容器中寻得杜阿特余烬$(br)4. 解碑文，完成亡灵试炼$(br)5. 合成杜阿特之心$(br)6. 获得圣咏、圣甲虫、项链与两地敕印。
